lede.description: One-sentence wire-style lede that names the actor, the act, the place, and the timeframe.

summary.description: Three-paragraph analyst summary (~150 words). Lead with what happened, then why it matters, then what to watch next. No speculation beyond what the sources support.

actors.description: Top 3-6 named actors (people or organizations) appearing across the sources.

citations.description: Numbered citations matching [1], [2]… inline references in the summary.

angle.description: One-sentence suggested reporting angle: the question or under-covered facet a journalist could push next.
